Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* feat(onboarding): /welcome walkthrough flow (purses-ka23, task 1)

Self-contained, client-only first-run walkthrough over bundled sample
items — no DB, no API, no new deps. Five beats (Purpose, Triage, Compare,
Standing, Handoff) reusing the DS (TierBadge, Button, Playfair, tokens).
The compare choice drives the Standing ranking (earned aha); pure
buildStanding is unit-tested. Skippable every beat, tap-first, ≥44px
targets, no essential motion. Copy verbatim from the spec; copy-guard
test forbids marketplace/price/buy/cart/shop language.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* feat(onboarding): first-run gate, dismissal, and profile re-open (purses-ka23, task 2)

Auto-trigger the /welcome walkthrough for a signed-in user with zero
collections who hasn't dismissed it, centralized in one WelcomeGate client
component mounted on the collections page. Dismissal is a device-local
localStorage flag (adored-welcome-dismissed) set on Skip and on Hand-off
completion, read by the gate; re-open via a quiet "How Adored works" link on
the profile does not clear it. All localStorage access is SSR-guarded and
centralized in dismissal.ts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* fix(onboarding): server-side welcome redirect via cookie to kill first-run flash

The first-run gate flashed the collections chrome before redirecting:
WelcomeGate redirected client-side in a useEffect while mounted inside the
server-rendered collections page. Switch the dismissal signal from
localStorage to a cookie so the collections server component can read it
via next/headers and redirect("/welcome") BEFORE rendering — no SSR paint.

Extract the decision into a pure shouldShowWelcome(count, dismissed) so it
stays in one place and is unit-testable. Remove the now-defunct client
WelcomeGate and its test (refs purses-ka23).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* test(screenshots): capture /welcome onboarding walkthrough (all 5 beats)

Drive the client-only /welcome route by role/accessible-name through
Purpose → Triage (×3) → Compare → Standing → Hand-off, shooting a
full-page screenshot at each beat in both themes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* fix(onboarding): replace sample images with verified object-only photos

The /welcome walkthrough shipped Openverse demo photos that included people
and landscapes (a shirtless man as "sunglasses", a woman in a park as
"scarf") — wrong for the anti-marketplace, "things you own" framing. Swap in
five visually verified object-only images (armchair, wall clock, flower vase,
throw cushion, bookshelf) from the committed homeware demo set, all CC BY /
BY-SA with attribution recorded in ATTRIBUTION.md. Update sampleData names and
the screenshot capture click target to match.
